genesis.20.p1.b1.text: Now Abraham journeyed from there to the region of the Negev and settled between Kadesh and Shur. While he was staying in Gerar,

genesis.20.p1.b2.text: Abraham said of his wife Sarah, “She is my sister.” So Abimelech king of Gerar had Sarah brought to him.

genesis.20.p1.b3.text: You are as good as dead because of the woman you have taken, for she is a married woman.

genesis.20.p2.b4.text: Lord, would You destroy a nation even though it is innocent?

genesis.20.p2.b5.text: I have done this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands.

genesis.20.p2.b6.text: Yes, I know that you did this with a clear conscience, and so I have kept you from sinning against Me. That is why I did not let you touch her.

genesis.20.p2.b7.text: Now return the man’s wife, for he is a prophet; he will pray for you and you will live.

genesis.20.p3.b8.text: Early the next morning Abimelech got up and summoned all his servants; and when he described to them all that had happened,

genesis.20.p3.b10.text: What have you done to us? … You have done things to me that should not be done.

genesis.20.p3.b11.text: What prompted you to do such a thing?

genesis.20.p4.b12.text: I thought to myself, ‘Surely there is no fear of God in this place. They will kill me on account of my wife.’

genesis.20.p4.b13.text: Besides, she really is my sister, the daughter of my father—though not the daughter of my mother—and she became my wife.

genesis.20.p4.b14.text: So when God had me journey from my father’s house, I said to Sarah, ‘… Wherever we go, say of me, “He is my brother.” …’

genesis.20.p5.b15.text: So Abimelech brought sheep and cattle, menservants and maidservants, and he gave them to Abraham and restored his wife Sarah to him.

genesis.20.p5.b16.text: Look, my land is before you. Settle wherever you please. …

genesis.20.p5.b17.text: See, I am giving your brother a thousand pieces of silver. It is your vindication before all who are with you; you are completely cleared.

genesis.20.p5.b18.text: Then Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech and his wife and his maidservants, so that they could again bear children—
